s2_h2: Which Site Office Container Fits Your Project Programme?
s2_paragraphs: Start with how many people sign in every morning, not with the length of the box. Width sets the desk count here. A 20 x 8 ft cabin seats three along one wall and keeps a clear central aisle. Move to 10 or 12 ft of width and a second desk run opens up, which is why the 40 x 12 ft layout reaches twelve workstations. Length then decides whether you get one open room or a manager cabin behind a partition.

Compare that against the rest of [the container office range](https://www.samanportable.com/product/container-offices) before you commit. This page suits a live construction plot, where the office moves as the work front moves. Mud, dust and visitors all arrive at the same door. If the programme is fixed and the office stays put for years, a different build usually costs less. Send us the plot layout and the headcount, and we will mark the size on a GA plan. [Send your site details for a quotation](https://www.samanportable.com/contact).

s3_variants.h2: 20 x 8 ft Site Office Container for a Three-Desk Team
s3_variants.body: At 160 sq ft this is the smallest office SAMAN will sign a GA plan for. Three workstations sit along the rear wall, each with a chair and an overhead file cabinet. The aisle down the middle stays clear, so nobody squeezes past a drawing table. One door on the front wall keeps entry controlled at a single point. Six windows give cross light. At 8 ft of width there is no room for a second desk run. Treat three seats as the honest limit.
bullets: Rs 2,37,600 ex GST, Rs 2,80,368 with 18 per cent GST
1 door, 6 windows, 3 workstations, 3 seats, no partition
Fits a narrow gate-side plot or a footpath-width setback
Smallest unit that still takes a full plan table

s3_variants.h2: 20 x 10 ft Site Office Container Seating Five People
s3_variants.body: Two extra feet of width change the plan completely. Five workstations now fit, three along the rear wall and two along the front, and the aisle still runs clear between them. This is the size most Indian site teams settle on for a mid-size project. It holds a site engineer, a supervisor, a billing assistant and two more desks without feeling cramped. The door and window positions match the 20 x 8 ft plan, so the entry discipline stays the same.
bullets: Rs 2,70,000 ex GST, Rs 3,18,600 with 18 per cent GST
1 door, 6 windows, 5 workstations, 5 seats, no partition
200 sq ft is the reference size for our published rate
Cross ventilation from windows on all four walls

s3_variants.h2: 30 x 10 ft Site Office Container With Two Site Doors
s3_variants.body: Thirty feet of length brings a second door, and that changes how the room works. Site staff enter at one end in boots, while visitors and clients use the other. Eight workstations line up, five along the rear wall and three along the front, with eight windows spreading daylight down the whole run. We keep this at eight desks rather than pushing to twelve, because a project office needs floor space for plan tables and standing conversations.
bullets: Rs 3,88,800 ex GST, Rs 4,58,784 with 18 per cent GST
2 doors, 8 windows, 8 workstations, 8 seats, no partition
Separate entry and exit points for staff and visitors
Comfortable eight-seat plan, not a maximum-capacity plan

s3_variants.h2: 40 x 8 ft Site Office Container With a Manager Cabin
s3_variants.body: This is the first layout with a partition. The first 10 ft becomes a private manager cabin with its own desk and two guest chairs, reached through an internal door. Behind it, a 30 ft common office runs seven workstations along one wall. Ten seats in total. At 8 ft of width the common room stays single-sided. Pick it when a closed meeting room matters more to you than want extra desks. An internal door keeps that room quiet.
bullets: Rs 4,10,400 ex GST, Rs 4,84,272 with 18 per cent GST
2 external doors plus 1 internal door, 10 windows
7 workstations and 10 seats, including manager and guests
Private cabin for wage talks, client visits and records

s3_variants.h2: 40 x 10 ft Site Office Container Seating Fifteen People
s3_variants.body: Ten feet of width lets both walls of the common office carry desks. Seven workstations sit along the rear wall and five along the front, which brings the total to twelve. Add the manager and two guest chairs and the cabin seats fifteen. The 10 ft manager room stays private behind the partition. Most infrastructure and EPC teams land here once the site crosses roughly forty people on the ground, and paperwork needs its own desks.
bullets: Rs 5,13,000 ex GST, Rs 6,05,340 with 18 per cent GST
2 external doors plus 1 internal door, 10 windows
12 workstations and 15 seats across two desk runs
Manager cabin reads as a 10 x 10 ft room, not a corner

s3_variants.h2: 40 x 12 ft Site Office Container With a Wide Clear Aisle
s3_variants.body: The widest approved layout carries the same twelve workstations as the 40 x 10 ft plan. What you buy with the extra two feet is the aisle. Seven feet of clear floor runs between the two desk runs, so a plan table opens without anyone standing up. The manager cabin also gains width. Choose this when the office doubles as the daily coordination room rather than only a desk space. Both desk runs still take the standard 4 x 2.5 ft module.
bullets: Rs 6,09,120 ex GST, Rs 7,18,762 with 18 per cent GST
2 external doors plus 1 internal door, 10 windows
12 workstations and 15 seats, same as the 40 x 10 ft plan
Seven-foot clear aisle for plan tables and site meetings

spec_tables.title: Table 1: Dimensions, structure, chassis, envelope, roof and floor
rows: Approved sizes
Six sizes from 20 x 8 x 8.5 ft to 40 x 12 x 8.5 ft, external height 8 ft 6 in on all
Bottom frame
125 x 75 x 4 mm MS C-channel, welded perimeter
Bottom stiffeners
100 x 50 x 3 mm channels with 80 x 40 x 2.5 mm MS tubular bracing
Floor frame
80 x 40 x 2.5 mm primary members with 50 x 50 x 2 mm secondary members
Top frame
50 x 50 x 2 mm MS square-pipe perimeter
Roof stiffeners
50 x 50 x 2 mm rafters with 40 x 40 x 2 mm purlins
Corner posts and wall frame
50 x 50 x 2.5 mm MS square-pipe posts, openings framed into the grid
Exterior walls
1.25 mm corrugated HR or MS sheet, vertical profile
Roof
1.4 mm corrugated MS sheet laid to a defined fall with sealed laps
Floor base
18 mm Bison panel, supported at all edges and sealed before installation
Floor finish
2 mm commercial vinyl with welded or sealed joints and skirting
External finish
One red-oxide primer coat and two anti-rust enamel coats in an approved colour combination
Lifting and handling
Designed MS hooks or lugs matched to the completed unit weight, used only per the approved lifting drawing
Welding and fabrication
Welded MS to approved shop drawings, cleaned joints, safe edges, dimensional inspection, coating touch-up

spec_tables.title: Table 2: Insulation, interior, openings, electrical, services and scope
rows: Wall insulation
50 mm glass wool within the framed cavity
Roof insulation
75 mm glass wool, kept continuous around rafters, lights and AC routes
Interior walls
8 to 12 mm pre-laminated MDF or plywood with backing for boards and storage
Ceiling
8 mm pre-laminated ceiling board with reachable inspection access
Doors
3 x 7 ft, 34 mm BWP flush leaf in a powder-coated MS frame with upgraded hardware
Windows
4 x 3 ft powder-coated aluminium with 5 mm glass, 3 ft 6 in sill and 6 ft 6 in head
Opening protection
Security grill, insect mesh, guard or louver only where the approved opening schedule requires
Fasteners and sealing
Corrosion-compatible fasteners, EPDM or butyl washers, closed-cell closures, approved PU or silicone sealants
Electrical wiring
Concealed PVC-insulated copper. Indicative 1.5 sq mm lighting, 2.5 sq mm sockets, 4 sq mm AC. Final size follows the approved load schedule
Electrical protection
Distribution board with MCB and RCCB protection, protective earthing, circuit segregation per the approved electrical drawing
Electrical fittings
LED lighting, data points, UPS provision, 6A and 16A sockets, fan points and a dedicated AC circuit
Ventilation and cooling
Cross ventilation with wall or ceiling fans and split-AC provision. The AC unit itself is an option, not an inclusion
Plumbing and sanitary
Excluded. No toilet in these six 8 to 12 ft wide layouts. A toilet needs a separate approved 16 to 20 ft plan
Layout and partition
Open plan at 20 and 30 ft. A 10 ft manager cabin behind a partition with an internal door on all three 40 ft plans
Quality checks
Pre-dispatch inspection of dimensions, member and sheet identification, welds, coating, roof drainage, weather sealing, openings and electrical continuity
Warranty
Period and exclusions confirmed in the final quotation only. Relocation damage, misuse, site services and unapproved alterations stay outside scope
Excluded from the published price

Interior fit-out beyond the specified lining, loose furniture, optional equipment, transport, unloading, craneage, installation, foundations, site utilities and project-specific engineering or certification

spec_narrative: Read these two tables as a buying decision, not as a datasheet. The frame sizes in table 1 explain why this cabin can be lifted and moved between work fronts, and why the floor takes a plan table and a filing unit without flexing. Table 2 settles the arguments that usually surface after the order. Cable sizes are indicative until the load schedule is approved. The AC circuit is included and the AC unit is not. There is no toilet in any of these six layouts. Warranty terms live in your quotation, not on this page.
